docs.pageSubtitle: Learn how to use all the features Arkan has to offer.

proposalGenerator.title: Proposal Generator
proposalGenerator.description: The Proposal Generator is the starting point for your projects. Describe your idea in a few sentences, and our AI will create a comprehensive, professional project proposal.
proposalGenerator.step1: Navigate to the 'Builder' and select the 'Proposal Mode' tab.
proposalGenerator.step2: Enter a clear description of your project idea into the text area.
proposalGenerator.step3: Click 'Generate Proposal' and review the structured output, which you can edit directly.

reportGenerator.title: Report Generator
reportGenerator.description: Once you have a proposal, the Report Generator can build out a full document, section by section, based on the proposal's context.
reportGenerator.step1: Ensure a proposal is loaded in the 'Proposal Mode' tab.
reportGenerator.step2: In the 'Document Generator' tab, open the accordion for the section you want to generate (e.g., Introduction, System Analysis).
reportGenerator.step3: Adjust any guidelines or controls for the AI.
reportGenerator.step4: Click the 'Generate' button for that section and watch the content appear.

diagramGenerator.title: Diagram Generator
diagramGenerator.description: Visualize your system's architecture, user flows, and database schemas with AI-powered PlantUML diagramming.
diagramGenerator.step1: In the 'Diagram Generator' tab, select the type of diagram you wish to create (e.g., Use Case, Class, Sequence).
diagramGenerator.step2: Provide additional context by selecting relevant report sections or other diagrams.
diagramGenerator.step3: Click 'Generate' to produce the PlantUML code and a preview image.

codeGenerator.title: Code Generator
codeGenerator.description: Need a UI component? Describe it in plain language, and the Code Generator will provide you with the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
codeGenerator.step2: Write a clear prompt describing the component, its appearance, and its behavior (e.g., 'A responsive login form with a show/hide password button').

presentationGenerator.title: Presentation Generator
presentationGenerator.description: Instantly convert your project proposal and report sections into a professional slide deck.
presentationGenerator.step1: After generating a proposal and some report content, switch to the 'Presentation Mode' tab.
presentationGenerator.step2: Select which report sections you want to include as context for the presentation.
presentationGenerator.step3: Click 'Generate Presentation' to create a full set of slides with titles, bullet points, and speaker notes.

academicSolver.title: Academic Solver
academicSolver.description: Upload an academic document like an exam or homework in PDF format, and let the AI analyze the questions and provide detailed solutions.
academicSolver.step1: Navigate to the 'Academic Solver' page from the header.
academicSolver.step2: Select whether you are uploading an 'Exam' or 'Homework'.
academicSolver.step3: Upload a PDF file containing the questions.
academicSolver.step4: The AI will first analyze and structure the document, then you can click 'Solve' to generate the answers.

admin.title: Admin Panel
admin.description: The admin panel provides a comprehensive suite of tools for managing the entire application.
admin.step1: Access the admin panel via the user dropdown menu in the header (visible only to admin accounts).
admin.step2: Use 'Manage Users' to view, edit, or delete user accounts and adjust their credit balances.
admin.step3: Use 'Manage Agents' and 'Manage Templates' to configure the behavior and output of the AI generation tools.
admin.step4: Review 'Activity History' to monitor all AI generations across the platform.
